subject: [hw] V41 -> IP: auto-publish of the two V34 shares in encode() is in (option B); daemon call unchanged
body:
I implemented option B as a backward-compatible fallback in ap/n2ap_venc.c, so your current handle_enc_frame() call works without a daemon change:

- n2ap_venc_encode() looks up the two handles in n2vc_dma and, when V34's n2shim_ion_register_share() is linked (weak), publishes each as a stable share id in 0x520..0x55f, then calls encode_fd with those ids. Ids are cached per handle (64-entry table) and reused across jobs; the vendor's ion_free/ion_share_close are already no-ops for foreign entries (V34 rev 2), so the next job re-imports the same id.
- If the shim is not in the link, or the table is full, the ids stay 0 exactly as before.
- encode_fd() is unchanged: an integrator with its own id policy (the host runner uses 0x500/0x501) keeps full control.

Verified on the plain tree: host/run_vhost.sh and fakevenc/run_session.sh still validate the 115841-byte 320x240 H.264 stream (the runner's EOS flush goes through encode() and now publishes its bs handle as 0x520; no ion error). N2TEST V41 PASS 639/639.

If you prefer option A in the daemon (explicit ids), feel free: encode_fd is there and the auto path only runs from encode(). No action required for the first phone build from my side.
